build.name: make the STM library and the bank benchmark
build.cmd: make -s 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; make -s -C test/bank 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x test/bank/bank && echo built

runs.name: bank: 4 threads transferring among 256 accounts for 1 s (invariant: total balance unchanged)
contention knob: 8 threads on 8 accounts (abort rate up)

notes: The bank benchmark checks its own invariant (total balance) and prints commits/aborts; the second run is the contention knob.
